title: Arkani-Hamed's positive geometries outside spacetime

tellings.quote: and what they're finding so Nemo was one of the first pioneers in this era um is structures that they call positive geometries outside of spaceime.

plain: Physicists led by Nima Arkani-Hamed at the Institute for Advanced Study in Princeton are said to be finding what they call "positive geometries outside of spacetime", mathematical structures that seem to sit beneath space and time and from which physics can be worked out. The scientist Donald Hoffman describes this work, naming Arkani-Hamed as one of its first pioneers and also mentioning the physicist David Gross. Hoffman raises it because it would mean space and time are not the bottom layer of reality.
